fields.description: Issue includes an editorial questioning the legality and advisability of parking meters at the International Airport; extensive coverage of Miami Beach city-manager and council conflict involving Claude Renshaw and police-department appointment powers; reporting on Miami municipal court cases alleging vice-raid abuses and police conduct; advocacy and coupons regarding opposition to a Florida sales tax and discussion of state governance and gambling legislation; local items on rental housing coming to market, school registration fees for transient children, and civic planning including proposed public library location at Bayfront Park. Includes entertainment/nightlife notices and health-related columns and advertisements.
